items.followUp: When does an AND operation produce a false output?

rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying AND as a logical or Boolean operator.

rubric.why: An AND operation produces a true output only when all its inputs are true.
rubric.description: States the condition for a true output.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that all inputs must be true for the output to be true.

modelAnswer: It produces a true output only when all its inputs are true; otherwise, the output is false.

items.followUp: Give two examples of communication channels used to transmit data.

rubric.why: A communication channel is the medium or path used to transmit data.
rubric.description: Defines a communication channel as a medium or path.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying it as a medium or path for data transmission.

rubric.why: The channel carries data between the communicating parties or devices.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it carries data between a sender and a receiver, or between devices.

modelAnswer: A communication channel is the medium or path through which data is transmitted.
It carries data from a sender to a receiver.

items.followUp: What does a server do after receiving a request from a client?

rubric.why: The client begins communication by sending a request to the server over a network.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the client sends a request to the server.

rubric.why: The server processes the request and returns a response to the client.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the server sends a response to the client.

modelAnswer: The client sends a request to the server over a network.
The server processes the request and sends a response back to the client.

items.followUp: How can a user access a file stored in Google Drive from another device?

rubric.why: Google Drive is an online cloud storage service.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying Google Drive as a cloud storage service or stating that it stores files online.

rubric.why: Users can access and share files stored in Google Drive over the internet.
rubric.description: States a practical use of the service.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning that users can access or share stored files over the internet.

modelAnswer: Google Drive is a cloud storage service that lets users store files online.
Users can access and share their files over the internet from different devices.
